failure_point: The first deterministic Wednesday candidate was rejected by archived get_instrument with JSON-RPC code -32602, message 'Invalid params', data.reason='wrong format', data.param='instrument_name'. No accepted contract metadata and no lifecycle trade payload had been acquired before failure.
authorized_transport_interpretation: For the deterministic Wednesday candidate enumeration only, an exact get_instrument error with code -32602 AND data.param='instrument_name' AND data.reason='wrong format' is treated as a nonexistent-candidate miss, equivalent to instrument-not-found. It is not accepted as a contract and does not enter any threshold denominator.
why_scientific_contract_is_unchanged: The calendar candidate list, exact naming rule, acceptance metadata conditions, source thresholds, trade endpoint, contract-life bounds and all outcome firewalls remain unchanged. This only maps a provider-specific negative exact-lookup response to the prospectively defined candidate-miss state.
forbidden_changes: do not alter candidate Wednesday dates
do not add observed instrument dates manually
do not lower source viability thresholds
do not open price, direction, basis, convergence, return or PnL outcomes
canonical_rerun_requirement: A new commit must patch only candidate-miss handling and rerun the same DVOL-TS-LIFECYCLE-SOURCE-001 authority.
